scene: You cross the creaky footbridge to the high transit junction.
picture: Flat side view along the wooden transit platform. On the far left waits a yellow bicycle rickshaw with a cap-wearing driver. Centre stands a brass spiral staircase lift cage with an open gate. The player stands between them facing right. On the far right hangs a striped open gondola of a giant ferris wheel.
